ocr.markdown:
SEASON'S BEST SHRIMP DIP
1 8oz. PKG. PHILADELPHIA BRAND CREAM
CHEESE, SOFTENED
1/2 CUP MIRACLE WHIP SALAD DRESSING
1 4¼ oz. CAN TINY COCKTAIL
SHRIMP, DRAINED RINSED
1/3 CUP FINELY CHOPPED
GREEN ONION
1/8 TSP. GARLIC SALT
• MIX CREAM CHEESE AND SALAD
DRESSING UNTIL WELL BLENDED.
• STIR IN REMAINING INGREDIENTS.
CHILL.
• SERVE WITH VEGETABLE DIPPERS.
2 CUPS.
PREP TIME: 10 MINS. PLUS CHILLING.
